lenses.label: Comparable products
lenses.ask: What do similar products offer? Which features are table stakes and which are differentiators?

lenses.label: Industry standards
lenses.ask: Which standards, conventions and best practices apply (for example WCAG, OWASP, REST and HTTP semantics, file formats)?

lenses.label: Users and accessibility
lenses.ask: Who uses this, what do they expect, and which accessibility needs are common?

lenses.label: Technology options
lenses.ask: Which stacks and libraries fit, with their licensing, maturity and trade-offs?

lenses.label: Pitfalls
lenses.ask: What commonly goes wrong in projects like this?

lenses.label: Security, privacy and compliance
lenses.ask: Which data is sensitive, and which regulations may apply (for example GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, COPPA)?

lenses.label: Costs and hosting
lenses.ask: What will it cost to run? Which free tiers exist and what are their limits?

lenses.label: MVP scope
lenses.ask: What is the smallest version worth shipping, and what can wait?

lenses.label: This repository
lenses.ask: What already exists in this repository that the plan must build on (code, conventions, dependencies, tests)? Read the code only; do not search the web for this lens.
